items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-setup-base-change, for X -> S locally of finite type and X' the base change along S' -> S, the lemma asserts that the map g^* : Z_k(X) -> Z_{k+c}(X') factors through rational equivalence to give a map CH_k(X) -> CH_{k+c}(X') (statement lines 15254-15264). The proof takes a k-cycle alpha rationally equivalent to zero and uses Lemma labelled lemma-rational-equivalence-family to write alpha = sum ([(W_i)_0]_k - [(W_i)_infinity]_k) for a locally finite family of integral closed subschemes W_i of X x P^1 of delta-dimension k not contained in the fibres over 0 or infinity (proof lines 15266-15278). It therefore suffices to prove two things for such an integral W with base change W' in X' x P^1: that W' satisfies the hypotheses of Lemma labelled lemma-closed-subscheme-cross-p1 with k replaced by k + c, and that g^*[W_0]_k = [(W')_0]_{k+c} and similarly at infinity (proof lines 15280-15288). Part (2) follows from Lemma labelled lemma-pullback-coherent-base-change together with the fact that (W')_0 is the base change of W_0; part (1) has the dimension statement from Lemma labelled lemma-dimension-base-change, and the absence of associated points on W'_0 follows because the equation t of the divisor 0 in P^1_S is a nonzerodivisor on the local ring O_{W,w} (as W is integral and not equal to W_0) and flatness of O_{W,w} -> O_{W',w'} preserves that (proof lines 15290-15299). Transporting the rational equivalence through the base change by controlling the two special fibres of an integral family and checking the nonzerodivisor condition by flatness is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
